question: A new employee must be granted access to add VLANs into an existing Cisco UCS Manager and configure NTP synchronization with date and time zone settings. Which two privileges must be granted to the employee to complete the task? (Choose two.)
theory: Cisco UCS Manager privilege names map to specific configuration domains: the Ext LAN Policy privilege (ext-lan-policy) governs global LAN-cloud-wide policies such as NTP synchronization and system date/time-zone settings, while the Ext LAN Config privilege (ext-lan-security) governs LAN configuration objects such as VLANs. Neither privilege alone covers both required tasks, so both must be granted together instead of assigning a broader role like network-admin, keeping the user's access scoped to only what is needed. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 19 - UCS RBAC privilege model)
